updated_records.title: SDZ — Système de dépollution de zone
updated_records.summary: Francouzský SDZ je teleoperovaný ženijní systém pro zabezpečování a odminování rozsáhlých prostorů; oficiální Armée de Terre materiál potvrzuje dva teleoperované roboty, výrobce CEFA, návaznost na požadavek od roku 2010 a náhradu MADEM.

technical_profile.configuration: Two tele-operated robots mounted on chassis
technical_profile.weight: 10 t stated for the system/vehicle in TerreMag; per-robot interpretation not assumed

operational_evidence.text: Official Army material describes the system as an Army engineer capability; exact current fleet quantity was not re-confirmed in B13.

intelligence_gaps: Exact current fleet quantity and unit distribution
Full public technical specifications and tool set
Precise doctrinal mapping of French dépollution terminology to NATO EOC/route-area-clearance categories

claims.text: SDZ is tele-operated and composed of two robots.
SDZ was developed by CEFA after a requirement expressed from 2010 and replaces MADEM.
TerreMag describes the vehicle/system as 10 tonnes.

updated_records.title: SYFRALL modular wet-gap crossing system
updated_records.summary: SYFRALL je francouzský modulární systém překonávání vodních překážek. DGA objednala 30. 12. 2025 osm systémů (~300 m), s dodáním prvních osmi do konce 2030; oficiální Eurosatory profil současně uvádí, že systém zatím není operačně nasazen a státní kvalifikační zkoušky mají začít v roce 2028.

technical_profile.remote_features: Remote control of motors to reduce personnel footprint

operational_evidence.qualification: State qualification trials planned to begin in 2028

intelligence_gaps: Configuration-specific MLC values from independent authoritative testing

claims.text: DGA ordered eight SYFRALL systems on 30 Dec 2025, representing about 300 linear metres, for French Army engineer regiments.
The first eight systems are planned for delivery before the end of 2030.
The official Eurosatory profile states operational deployment: No, and state qualification trials beginning in 2028.
The system uses 11 m floating modules, 8x8 tractor/trailer transport and remote control of motors.

updated_records.title: BLT Arjun
updated_records.summary: BLT Arjun je mostní tank na podvozku MBT Arjun. Oficiální DRDO karta potvrzuje MLC-70, dvoučlennou osádku, 24m ocelový / 26m hliníkový most a desetiminutový čas položení/stažení.

technical_profile.mechanism: Slide launch, hydraulic, independent power unit

operational_evidence.text: DRDO product page confirms technical baseline; current Army fleet quantity, unit distribution and operational availability are not established by this source.

claims.text: BLT Arjun is built on MBT Arjun chassis and uses an MLC-70 bridge superstructure.
DRDO lists a two-person crew and 24 m steel / 26 m aluminium-alloy bridge options.

confirmations.fact: UK MOD public page still exposes AJP-3.18 Edition B Version 1, published 20 Feb 2024, as overarching NATO doctrine for EOD support to operations.
69th and 70th EOD WG reporting confirms ongoing EOC annex/study-draft and standardization work, but public pages still do not identify the exact parent standard/study-draft number.
Rostec continues to state UBIM was accepted into service with Russian Engineering Troops; independent unit-level 2026 fielding scale remains unverified.
